blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V159 renders: shortening the crest ramp does not make the repeated pleat cadence legible at product scale; broad flared skirt faces still dominate front, rear and side views.
Crouch and sit retain the angular upper-thigh shell edge and separated under-skirt faces; the shell does not follow bent thighs closely enough to establish coverage or fit.
Front and three-quarter views retain pinched/faceted lower torso patches and an uneven jacket-to-skirt join around the waist.
The prone render still shows the skirt as a rigid radial fan across the body and intersecting limbs, without plausible cloth drape.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
